title: Power transition of the ordinary coefficient root-line chart
statement: Let P be a finite purity setting, T a scheme over its base field, c a natural number, and zeta,zeta_prime primitive P.diagonalExponent-th roots with zeta=zeta_prime^c. For the ordinary root-line trivializations defined by [def-pur-finite-reduction-root-charts], the inverse chart at zeta_prime equals c times the inverse chart at zeta, as morphisms of etale coefficient-module sheaves. This is repeated addition of morphisms and includes empty T.

source.place: Step 2: compatibility with invertible twists by tensor associativity; expansion of the specified normalized primitive-root charts.

proof.text: Compose the normalized root sections with the injective kernel inclusion into Gm. The sheafification unit and the explicit root map a ↦ zeta^a identify the two section images. The relation zeta=zeta_prime^c therefore gives rootSection(zeta)=c rootSection(zeta_prime). Check the root-line maps on constant scalar sections, then use sheafification uniqueness: their forward homs satisfy t_zeta=c t_zeta_prime. Cancel the two isomorphisms to obtain t_zeta_prime inverse=c t_zeta inverse. Single complexes and shift preserve this equality.

proof_origin.source: Explicit normalized root-section calculation and induction on the existing ordered tensor recursion, expanding finite-reduction proof Step 2.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteReductionRootTrivialization_inv_power (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [T.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))] (c : ℕ) (ζ ζ' : P.field.k)
    (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ P.diagonalExponent)
    (hζ' : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ' P.diagonalExponent) (hc : ζ = ζ' ^ c) :
    (P.finiteReductionRootTrivialization T ζ' hζ').inv =
      c • (P.finiteReductionRootTrivialization T ζ hζ).inv
